_comment: Example Host-owned gate configuration for the peer-dispatch boundary. Copy next to peer-mcp-server.mjs as peer-ena-gate.json, replace the placeholders, and the bridge will refuse ordinary peer work whose ENA home is not ready while keeping a Host-owned repair lane. Delete or rename the file to switch the gate off entirely.
_unregisteredPolicy_comment: pass = a request naming an unregistered workspace runs exactly as before. refuse = the Host additionally requires every workspace to be registered here, while a request carrying no workspace (the coordination channel) still passes.

values._comment: Every value a repair action uses is owned by the Host. The caller cannot supply any of them, which is what keeps the repair lane from becoming a general command runner.
values.recoveryPath: <path to recovery material you have actually rehearsed>

bootstrap._comment: Bootstrap covers cold and incremental repair alike. A narrower variant that re-states only the confirmed values does NOT restore an expired home, so the lane must carry the verified recovery and rescuer facts to re-issue the freshness window.
